title: Synthesis of derivatization reagent TAHS
author: Manuel Liebeke
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j8ycrxw

steps.title: Synthesize Intermediate Product
steps.instruction: React DSC and DPD in dry ACN at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 6.0 g (23.4 mmol) of DSC in 250 mL of dry ACN.
Add 3.0 g (22.0 mmol) of DPD dissolved in 250 mL of dry ACN dropwise over 45 minutes.
Stir the mixture at room temperature.

steps.title: Isolate and Purify Intermediate
steps.instruction: Concentrate the product and filter to remove impurities.

substeps.instruction: Concentrate the product using rotary evaporation.
Resuspend the residue in 5 mL ACN.
Filter the suspension through Whatman filter paper No.2 Qualitative.
Verify purity via mass-spectrometry (m/z 278.1141 [M +H]+, formula C13H16N3O4) and NMR.

steps.title: Derivatize to TAHS
steps.instruction: React the intermediate with iodomethane to produce TAHS.

substeps.instruction: Concentrate the filtrate and redissolve it in 10 mL of 4:1 ACN:DCM.
Allow the reaction to proceed overnight at room temperature.

steps.title: Recover and Verify TAHS
steps.instruction: Filter the reaction mixture to obtain the final product and verify its identity.

substeps.instruction: Filter the reaction mixture to afford approximately 0.3 g of TAHS (6.55 mmol, 29.8% yield over 2 steps).
Verify purity via mass-spectrometry (m/z 292.1297 [M]+, formula C14H18N3O4, Δ -2.9 ppm) and NMR.
